summary:
Zscaler EPS 超預期 7.11%、營收年增 25.4%，本益比資料缺失（GAAP 虧損），盤後下跌 0.29%，Zero Trust 安全需求穩健但高估值仍是顧慮。
• EPS $1.08 超越預估 $1.01，驚喜幅度 +7.11%，非 GAAP 獲利能力持續改善。
• 單季營收 $8.50 億美元，年增 25.4%，Zero Trust 網路安全架構需求持續驅動訂閱成長。
• 本益比資料缺失（null），市值 $209 億美元，顯示公司在 GAAP 層面仍處於虧損或盈虧邊緣。
• 盤後股價下跌 0.29%，即便超預期仍收跌，顯示市場期待更高的年增率或指引上修。
• 25.4% 年增率在雲端安全網關市場中屬穩健，但相較帕羅奧圖的 31.1% 略顯遜色。
ai_view:
Zscaler 本季財報屬「達標但不夠突出」格局——7.11% EPS 驚喜反映非 GAAP 獲利能力改善，但 25.4% 的年增率相較主要競爭對手稍顯遜色，盤後微跌印證市場期待更高。Zero Trust 安全需求是結構性長期主題，Zscaler 仍是該領域的核心受益者，惟在競爭加劇下成長加速的可見度偏低。短期動能偏中性偏弱；中期而言，若能在政府與大型企業客戶中提升平台採用廣度（SASE 策略），有望帶動成長加速。需追蹤指標：年度經常性收入（ARR）成長率、大客戶（$1M+ ARR）數量成長、政府合約佔比、以及下季收入指引年增率是否回升至 28% 以上。對比帕羅奧圖，Zscaler 需要呈現更明確的成長加速訊號方能脫穎而出。

需留意：本益比資料缺失且市值 $209 億，若 GAAP 虧損狀態延長，融資成本上升將壓縮財務彈性。；25.4% 年增率雖穩健，但帕羅奧圖 31.1% 的更強成長暗示 Zscaler 可能在企業平台整合競爭中處於劣勢。；Zero Trust 市場競爭升溫，微軟、CrowdStrike 均在強化相關能力，可能影響 Zscaler 的大客戶新增速度。

summary_en:
Zscaler beat EPS by 7.11% with 25.4% YoY revenue growth; the -0.29% post-earnings dip and missing P/E (GAAP losses) suggest the market wants stronger top-line acceleration.
• EPS of $1.08 beat the $1.01 estimate by 7.11%, reflecting improving non-GAAP profitability.
• Quarterly revenue of $850M grew 25.4% YoY, driven by Zero Trust architecture adoption across enterprises.
• P/E data is unavailable (null) on a $20.9B market cap, indicating GAAP losses or breakeven status.
• Post-earnings stock fell -0.29% despite the EPS beat, suggesting the market expected a stronger revenue growth rate or guidance uplift.
• 25.4% YoY growth is solid but trails PANW's 31.1%, reflecting competitive dynamics in cloud-delivered security.

ai_view_en:
Zscaler's quarter was competent but not compelling—7.11% EPS beat reflects non-GAAP profitability improvement, while 25.4% revenue growth trails key peers and a post-earnings dip confirms market disappointment. Zero Trust security is a secular long-term theme and Zscaler remains a core beneficiary, but competitive visibility for re-acceleration is limited. Near-term, momentum is neutral-to-negative. Medium-term upside depends on broadening platform adoption (SASE strategy) within government and large enterprise accounts. Key metrics to monitor: ARR growth rate, $1M+ ARR customer additions, government contract proportion, and whether next-quarter revenue guidance returns above 28% YoY. Relative to PANW, Zscaler needs a clearer re-acceleration signal to differentiate its investment case.

Watch：Absence of P/E data on a $20.9B cap suggests ongoing GAAP losses; if loss trajectory doesn't improve, financial flexibility could be constrained in a higher-rate environment.; Zscaler's 25.4% growth trails PANW's 31.1%, suggesting potential competitive disadvantage in enterprise platform consolidation deals.; Microsoft, CrowdStrike, and others are strengthening Zero Trust capabilities, potentially slowing Zscaler's large enterprise account additions.
beat_or_miss: 超預期 EPS 實際 $1.08 超越預估 $1.01，驚喜幅度 +7.11%，屬正向超預期。
